title: Lil Pills, Zeb and Blind Charlie: the lesser-known clarinetists
summary: Barnes recalls the clarinetists who played with Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly, how they played, and what they looked like and where they came from.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Well, I wanted to ask Emil about some of the clarinet players that you don't hear too much about now that he knows. The different ones that played with Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly and those guys way back. Not the clarinet players that would be known as reading musicians, but some of the other ones.

Well, I'll tell you something about that. The clarinet players that played with, well, I remember Lil Pills. That was the only name I knew anymore. Now they had another one that was the clarinet players that was the clarinet players that was the clarinet players. Now, the clarinet players that was from the lower coast. Then again, between time, they had another one there by the name of, let's see now what they call him. Charlie, Charlie, Charlie. Well, he was a pretty good clarinet player. That's about all I could remember of this time and mention that clarinet. Well, how would you describe the way they played, Mealy? Well, they were pretty fair. It wasn't out to call them musicians because they weren't much a breeder like myself. But at the meantime, they could take the place of pretty much any musicians. They were really good players. Would you say they had good ears? They could pick up tunes well? Oh, yes. You couldn't get away from them in no kind of way. It ain't because there was so much in them that what they couldn't get to, they'd violate them. With the old clarinet, the old clarinet players, they'd violate them. But I know what they call it now, but it makes something a little different.
Like a variation. Yeah. Now, who were they again? Let's see now, Zeb?
That was Zeb and Pills and Charlie. See, that's what Blind Charlie's called.
Blind Charlie. Well, how did these fellows look, Mealy? Would you describe them?

Well, Charlie was always near-sighted. Pills was a little short fellow, kind of yullish, yullish, you know, but he was crippled. He was crippled. And Zeb was a tall fellow, him, very slow in talking. He didn't talk much in that time. What part of town did they come from? Well, Zeb and Pills both was from the low coast. Yeah, that, what I would call it, Verrett, you see? That Verrett village. In other words, well, you see, Charlie was from here. He was from Mount Gravity Street. He was from Mount Gravity Street. Yeah, he was from Mount Gravity Street at that time.
